Class PythonStatic

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.context.python.PythonStatic
@Internal public final class PythonStatic extends Object
The Python semantics a statically compiled function body needs where Java's differ: the string form of values, division and modulo, and truthiness. Called by the generated stubs.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher

    static RuntimeException
    forPython(org.graalvm.polyglot.Value self, RuntimeException exception)
    The exception a compiled body called from Python throws instead: a failure the body raises where Python raises one (a division by zero, an assertion, + on None) becomes that Python exception, raised through the Python object's context, and a checked exception of a Java call is thrown as itself, as a Python caller of the Java method would see it.

    • raised

      public static RuntimeException raised(Class<?> generatedClass, org.graalvm.polyglot.Value exception)
      The Java exception a compiled raise of a Python exception class throws: the one the runtime creates when the Python exception reaches Java code, the generated class of its exception class created through its Value constructor (a failure of that constructor reported as an IllegalStateException, as for a Python raise). A generated class that cannot be created at all is an IllegalStateException naming it too, rather than an exception the compiled handlers of the exception class would not catch.
      Parameters:
      generatedClass - The generated class of the exception class
      exception - The Python exception, created by its class
      Returns:
      The Java exception to throw
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - When the generated class cannot be created for the Python exception

      public static void assertion(boolean condition, @Nullable String message)
      An assert statement: assertions are enabled in the runtime, so a false condition raises. A Python exception reaches a Java caller as a runtime exception, so the failure is one too rather than a AssertionError.

      condition - The condition
      message - The message, or null
      Throws:

    • returned

      public static org.graalvm.polyglot.Value returned(org.graalvm.polyglot.Value result, String method, String hint)
      The result of a Python method a compiled body calls whose return hint is a primitive (int, float or bool). Return hints are trusted, and checked for None: a None the primitive cannot hold fails as a TypeError naming the method and its hint, not as the NullPointerException of the conversion.
      Parameters:
      result - The result of the call
      method - The method, as Class.method
      hint - The Python name of the hinted type
      Returns:

      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - When the result is None, as a TypeError

The hint is trusted, and checked for None as returned(org.graalvm.polyglot.Value, String, String) checks a result.
      Parameters:

    • bindCompiled

      public static void bindCompiled(org.graalvm.polyglot.Value pythonObject, String owner, Object delegate)
      Binds a Python object to the compiled bodies of one class of its MRO: the rewritten methods of that class run the Java bodies for the object from then on, see apply_delegation. The binding is kept outside the object, weakly, so a copy of the object is not bound and the object's attributes are its own.
      Parameters:
      pythonObject - The Python object of a stub
      owner - The generated class whose compiled bodies are bound, as the rewritten methods name it
      delegate - The delegate of that class: a stateless Java object whose methods take the Python object first

    • forPython

      public static RuntimeException forPython(org.graalvm.polyglot.Value self, RuntimeException exception)
      The exception a compiled body called from Python throws instead: a failure the body raises where Python raises one (a division by zero, an assertion, + on None) becomes that Python exception, raised through the Python object's context, and a checked exception of a Java call is thrown as itself, as a Python caller of the Java method would see it.
      Parameters:
      self - The Python object the body ran on
      exception - The exception the body threw
      Returns:
      The exception to throw, when it has no Python counterpart
